title: 30 MINUTES MOST POWERFUL PSALM 121 MORNING PRAYER TO START YOUR DAY | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: Beloved, the Bible declares in Psalm 121:1-2, I will lift up mine eyes unto the heels from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the Lord which made heaven and earth. This morning as you rise, do not forget that your strength is not in men, not in systems, not in the arm of flesh. Your help comes from the Lord, the maker of heaven and earth. Hear me. To start a day without invoking the help of God is to walk into a battle unarmed.

To step into destiny without divine covering is to be vulnerable to arrows you cannot see. Today I announce to you your help will not fail. Your covenant keeping God will preserve you. Psalm 12178 says, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth and even forever more. That is a guarantee of preservation. That is a seal of protection. That is an assurance of safety.

Lift your voice and declare with fire, by the blood of Jesus, I receive preservation today. By the fire of God, no evil shall befall me. By divine authority, my going out is preserved. By the word of God, my coming in is secure. Every morning carries mysteries. There are arrows that fly by day. There are assignments of darkness programmed in the early hours. But Psalm 91:5 declares, "Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day."

That means the arrows exist, but they will not touch you. The terrors exist, but they will not come near you. Declare violently, by the blood of Jesus, I cancel every arrow of darkness fired against me today. By the fire of God, I scatter every demonic program. By divine authority, I frustrate the tokens of the wicked. By the word of God, I decree my safety. Hear me, child of God. Decree boldly, by the blood of Jesus, I arise today in glory. By the fire of God, I scatter every covering, cast over my destiny.

By divine authority, I command my light to shine. By the word of God, I decree nations will see my rising over your finances. Deuteronomy 8:18 says, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth." Many go out daily and labor, but without favor. Without divine assistance, labor becomes frustration. But today the Lord empowers you for wealth. Declare with power by the blood of Jesus. I cancel every financial embargo. By the fire of God, I scatter every altar of poverty.

By divine authority, I decree open doors of resources. By the word of God, I enforce abundance in my life, over your family. Psalm 127:1 says, "Except the Lord build the house, they labor in vain that build it." If your family is not covered by the Lord in the morning, manipulations will prevail. But this morning, your family is hidden under the shadow of the Almighty. Pray with holy anger. By the blood of Jesus, I cover my family today. By the fire of God, I scatter every satanic plot against my household.

By divine authority, I decree peace and preservation. By the word of God, I declare we are hidden in Christ. Over your health, Isaiah 33:24 says, "And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick." The enemy projects affliction early in the day, strange headaches, sudden pains, accidents, but today you rise with health in your body. Decree, by the blood of Jesus, I cancel every covenant of sickness. By the fire of God, I scatter manipulations against my health. By divine authority, I decrease strength in my body.

By the word of God, I declare no sickness shall. Now pray with militancy. By the blood of Jesus, I cancel every witchcraft projection for today. By the fire of God, I scatter every ancestral manipulation. By divine authority, I command the heavens to favor me. By the word of God, I legislate victory into my day. Lift your worship. Lord, you are my keeper, the shade upon my right hand. The sun shall not smite me by day, nor the moon by night. You preserve my going out and my coming in.

I worship you, my deliverer and my strength. Seal with decrees by the blood of Jesus. I decree this day is sanctified. By the fire of God, I decree evil is far from me. By divine authority, I decree angels go before me. By the word of God, I declare today is my day of testimony. Thus, sayeth the Lord, this morning marks a new season. No curse will prevail. No witchcraft will succeed. No altar will speak louder than the blood.

Go forth for the Lord is your keeper and your testimony is guaranteed in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I decree and declare today is preserved. Your life is secured. Your destiny will shine and your victory is permanent. Amen and amen. Beloved, hear me. The morning is not just the beginning of hours. The morning is the gate of the day. Whoever controls the morning controls the flow of the day.

This is why Job 22:28 says, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." Your decrees this morning are not empty words. They are spiritual legislations that must be established. Declare with faith, by the blood of Jesus, I decree this day is aligned with favor. By the fire of God, I scatter every orchestration of hell. By divine authority, I declare no enchantment shall prosper.

By the word of God, I lift your voice and declare, by the blood of Jesus, I condemn every evil tongue. By the fire of God, I scatter every weapon formed. By divine authority, I decree every arrow returns to sender. By the word of God, I enforce total victory over your finances. Genesis 26:12 says, "Then Isaac sowed in that land and received in the same year and hundfold, and the Lord blessed him. Even in famine, Isaac prospered. That is covenant exemption.

Today, no matter the economy, no matter the manipulations, you will prosper. Pray aggressively. By the blood of Jesus, I cancel financial attacks. By the fire of God, I scatter every devourer assigned to my resources. By divine authority, I decrease supernatural increase. By the word of God, I declare, I will prosper like Isaac over your family. Psalm 91:10 says, "There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

Witchcraft manipulations love to target families in the morning with sudden quarrels, accidents, or strange incidents. But this morning, we legislate peace." Declare, "By the blood of Jesus, I decree no evil shall befall my family today. By the fire of God, I scatter every agenda of tragedy. By divine authority, I enforce angelic protection over my household. By the word of God, I declare our dwelling is preserved over your health." Exodus 15:26 says, "For I am the Lord that health thee.

Every projection of affliction is reversed. The covenant of healing stands. Pray militantly. By the blood of Jesus, I cancel every health manipulation. By the fire of God, I scatter every arrow of infirmity. By divine authority, I enforce wholeness in my body. By the word of God, I decree divine health is my portion over restoration. Jo lift your worship. Lord, you are the shade upon my right hand. You preserve me from evil. You are the God who neither sleeps nor slumbers.

You are my help, my shield, my refuge, my fortress. I exalt you for being my keeper. Seal with decrees. By the blood of Jesus, I decree today is fruitful. By the fire of God, I decree no arrow shall touch me. By divine authority, I decree my life is secure. By the word of God, I declare my testimony is guaranteed. Thus sayaeth the Lord, your morning is sanctified, your day is blessed, your family is covered, your destiny is preserved. Go forth for the Lord himself is your keeper, your defense, and your shield.

In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I decree and declare today is sealed with the covenant of preservation. Angels go before you and victory is assured. Amen and amen. Listen carefully. Psalm 121:5-6 declares, "The Lord is thy keeper. The Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand. The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night." That means both the battles of the day and the battles of the night are under God's authority.

Evil projections that use the sun, the moon, and the stars to manipulate destinies are cancelled when the Lord becomes your shade. There are witchcraft operations that program afflictions into the day, but the word of God says the sun shall not smite you. There are sorceries that use the moon to enforce delay, but the word says the moon shall not harm you. Lift your voice and decree with power, by the blood of Jesus, I cancel every manipulation through the sun.

By the fire of God, I scatter every enchantment through the moon. By divine authority, I block every evil projection through the stars. By the word of God, I decree the Lord is my keeper over your family. Isaiah 8:18 says, "Behold, I and the children whom the Lord had given me are for signs and for wonders, but witchcraft covenants turn families into battlegrounds." This morning, your family will not be for shame. Your family will be for wonders.

Declare with fire, by the blood of Jesus, I cancel covenants of shame in my family. By the fire of God, I scatter every ancestral altar speaking against my bloodline. By divine authority, I decree my family is for signs and wonders. By the word of God, I enforce the covenant of blessing over your health. Malachi 4:2 says, "But unto you that fear my name shall the son of righteousness arise with healing in his wings. Every projection of affliction is overturned. Pray aggressively.

By the blood of Jesus, I cancel every witchcraft arrow of sickness. By the fire of God, I scatter every ancestral covenant of infirmity. By divine authority, I decree wholeness in my body. By the word of God, I receive healing from the son of righteousness. Over restoration, Isaiah 61:7 says, "For your shame, ye shall have double, and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion. Therefore, in their land they shall possess the double. Everlasting joy shall be unto them.

Whatever was stolen overnight, you shall possess double this morning. Lift your voice. By the blood of Jesus, I recover all stolen blessings. By the fire of God, I scatter every hand that diverted my portion. By divine authority, I decree double restoration. By the word of God, I enforce everlasting joy. Prophetic utterance. Thus say the Lord, the curse that tied your mornings to sorrow is broken. Someone here, every time you start the day with fear, the spirit of God says, "Peace is restored.

You will walk in confidence." Another person, the embargo on your prom. Thus sayaeth the Lord, your day is blessed. Your life is preserved. Your family is secured. Your destiny is lifted. Go forth for the Lord himself is your help, your defense, and your glory. In the name of Jesus Christ, I decree and declare this day is sealed by the covenant of preservation. Favor goes before you, angels surround you, and your testimony is guaranteed. Amen and amen.

We thank the Lord this morning for the privilege of life, for the breath in our nostrils, for the gift of another day. The psalm is declared in Psalm 35, I laid down and slept, I awoke, for the Lord sustained me. That you are alive this morning is proof that the mercy of God has kept you. That you are alive this morning is a sign that there is still a purpose for your destiny. And this morning, the Lord has brought us to a prophetic charge. If God is for you, no enemy can stand against you.

Romans 8:31 asks, "What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?" Child of God, this is not a rhetorical question. It is a verdict in the spirit. When God is for you, the opposition of men, the scheming of spirits, the arrows of darkness, the voices of accusation, they all become powerless. The confidence of the believer is not in connections, it is not in money, it is not in strength, it is not in strategy. The confidence of the believer is that God is for us.

Consider the story of Israel in Numbers 23:23 when Balac hired Balam to c the people of God. The Bible records, "For there is no sorcery against Jacob, nor any divination against Israel, it now must be said of Jacob and of Israel, oh what God has done." When God is for you, divination loses its power. Enchantment loses its voice. Curses lose their hold. I tell you by the spirit now I decree over your life. Every enemy that rises against you today will stumble and fall.

Isaiah 54:15 says indeed they shall surely assemble but not because of me. Whoever assembles against you shall fall for your sake. Every gathering against you, physical or spiritual, is scattered. Now I decree over your destiny no enchantment, no divination, no curse will stand. Galatians 3:13 says Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law having become a curse for us by the blood of Jesus. Every c is broken. Every covenant is anol. Every handwriting of ordinances is blotted out.

I decree over your health no sickness will prevail. Exodus 15:26 says, "For I am the Lord who heals you. Whatever affliction has risen against your body, it bows to the name of Jesus. Be healed, be strengthened, be restored. I decree over your family. No weapon formed against them will prosper." Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue which rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn. By the spirit of God, we condemn.

Every tongue of accusation, every voice of judgment, every word of witchcraft against your family, lift your hands and begin to pray in the spirit. As you pray, angels are moving. As you pray, walls are falling. As you pray, enemies are scattering. I prophesy over your work. The counsel of the wicked will not stand. Proverbs 19:21 says, "There are many plans in a man's heart. Nevertheless, the Lord's counsel that will stand.

The counsel of the Lord will stand over your business, over your career, over your ministry. I prophesy over your journeys today. Divine preservation. Lift your voice again and pray in tongues. Shaland, you are releasing fire into the camp of the enemy. You are enforcing victory. I decree restoration. Joel 2:25 says, "So I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, every year wasted by enemies, every opportunity stolen by adversaries, every blessing diverted by covenant, be restored now.

And now I bless you. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious to you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace today. Go with confidence. Go with assurance. Go with boldness. Because if God is for you, no enemy can stand against you. Surely goodness and mercy shall follow you. all the days of your life and you shall dwell in the house of the Lord forever. Amen. Let us continue in the river of the spirit. This morning's assurance remains unshaken.

If God is for you, no enemy can stand against you. The word of God says in Psalm 46:1, "God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore, we will not fear. Even though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea, when God is your refuge, you become untouchable by the storms of life. When God is your strength, the weight of opposition cannot break you. Hear me, child of God.

Many of the battles you face are not because you are weak, but because you are chosen. The enemy fights what he fears. He attacks where he sees destiny. He resists where he perceives light. But the word of God says in Isaiah 59:19, "When the enemy comes in like a flood, the spirit of the Lord will lift up a stand. I decree over your household preservation." Psalm 91:10 says, "No evil shall befall you, nor shall any plague come near your dwelling. Your home is shielded. Your children are covered.

Your marriage is protected. I decree over your health, healing flows into you right now. Jeremiah 3:17 says, "For I will restore health to you and heal you of your wounds, says the Lord. Every sickness bows, every affliction flees, every pain dissolves. In the name of Jesus, I decree over your mind peace." Philippians 4:7 says, "And the peace of God which surpasses all understanding will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus." Confusion is lifted. Anxiety is broken. Depression is gone.

Peace floods your soul. I decree over your destiny no delay. Habacook 2:3 says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it will speak and it will not lie. Though it tries, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry. Your destiny will speak. Your prophecy will manifest. Your promise will not fail." Now lift your hands and pray in the spirit.

I condemn. Every tongue of accusation, I silence every tongue of judgment. I nullify every tongue of witchcraft. I speak to your finances breakthrough."

Deuteronomy 28:12 says, "The Lord will open to you his good treasure, the heavens, to give the rain to your land in its season, and to pray again in the spirit shal." Joel 2:25 says, "So I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, every year stolen, every opportunity wasted, every blessing diverted be restored sevenfold. I decree protection." Psalm 91:11 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over you to keep you in all your ways. Angels surround you. Angels walk with you.

Angels fight for you. I decree favor. Psalm 102:13 says, "You will arise and have mercy on Zion for the time to favor her." Yes, the set time has come. Your set time has come. Doors are opening. Men are favoring you. Systems are aligning. And now I seal you with blessing. Numbers 6:24-26 says, "The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious to you." The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. Walk into this day with confidence. God is for you.
Therefore, no enemy can stand against you. Surely goodness and mercy shall follow you all the days of your life, and you shall dwell in the house of the Lord forever. Amen.
practice: Read Psalm 121:1–2 slowly. On the next familiar stretch of your journey, look up from the path. What reminds you that you do not have to be your own only source of help?
